purpose: Bind a verified GitHub Actions run/attempt, audience, operation and logical target to one semantic request digest so exact retries remain safe and changed-payload replays fail closed.
requestDigest: SHA-256 over PostgreSQL jsonb canonical text form
retryRule: An exact semantic retry under the same verified identity is permitted and recorded as replayed-exact. Rebinding the same identity to a different request digest, ref, workflow_ref or event_name is rejected-conflict.
invariants: The replay binder runs only after cryptographic GitHub OIDC verification.
Cross-audience and cross-operation reuse is accepted only for the explicitly allowed purpose map.
The first semantic request owns the identity key permanently.
Bindings and replay/conflict events are append-only and not writable by public application roles.
Exact retry does not create duplicate provider evidence.
